intro.title: Welcome to the official APG website
intro.text: Since 01.07.1921, a story has been written. Generations, memories, victories, emotions… and one shared passion: football. Today, a new page begins here. Follow us to discover the life of the club, our teams, our matches, our results and every moment that makes our story.

today.label: Today
today.title: A living club, at the heart of Geneva
today.text1: FC APG 1921 is part of Geneva's sporting landscape: three senior teams — the first team in the ACGF 4th league, plus two veterans sides +40 and +50 — wear the yellow and blue on the canton's pitches.
today.text2: But the club is also the volunteers who prepare the ground, the families along the touchline and the local partners behind our colours. A non-profit association driven by Geneva's Portuguese community and its friends.

items.q1: How do I join FC APG 1921?
items.a1: Come to a training session at the Centre Sportif de Vessy or message us on WhatsApp: a trial is possible at any time of the season.
items.q2: When do training sessions take place?
items.a2: Tuesday and Thursday at 19:30, Friday at 20:00 at the Centre Sportif de Vessy — up-to-date times are listed on this page.
items.q3: Do I need to be Portuguese to play?
items.a3: No. The club was born within Geneva's Portuguese community and welcomes players of every nationality.
items.q4: Where and when do you play your matches?
items.a4: At home at the Centre Sportif de Vessy, usually on Sunday mornings, in the championship of the Geneva regional football association (ACGF).

privacy.title: Privacy (FADP)
privacy.s1b: This website sets no advertising cookies and sells no data. The contact form opens a pre-filled WhatsApp conversation: your message is never sent to our servers. A simple anonymous visit counter, stored without IP addresses, measures site traffic.
privacy.s2b: The displayed weather comes from Open-Meteo and the map from OpenStreetMap. These services only receive the technical data required for the request (including your IP address).
privacy.s3b: Under the Swiss Federal Act on Data Protection (FADP), you may request access, rectification or deletion of your data by writing to the club's email address.
privacy.s4b: FC Association des Portugais de Genève — contact@fc-apg.ch.
